abstract: We evaluated p53 expression and tumor proliferative activity (TPA) using monoclonal antibodies to Ki-67 and proliferating cell nuclear antigen (PCNA) in 26 patients with seminomatous and nonseminomatous testicular germ-cell tumors (GCTs). Correlation between p53 expression and TPA, as well as the clinical correlation with the expression of these proteins were also assessed. There were eight cases of pure seminoma and 18 cases of nonseminomatous GCTs, collectively consisting of 45 tumors or tumor components. The nonseminomatous GCTs were mixed or pure and included choriocarcinoma (CC), embryonal carcinoma (EC), immature teratoma (IMT), mature teratoma (MT), seminoma, and yolk sac tumor (YST). The ages of the patients with seminomatous GCTs ranged from 24 to 47 years (mean, 34 years) and those for patients with nonseminomatous GCTs ranged from 17 to 43 years (mean, 29 years). Sixteen (44%) of the 36 nonseminomatous GCTs or tumor components were positive for p53 protein. Ten (91%) of eleven ECs, three (38%) of eight YSTs, two (20%) of ten MTs, and the single case of CC were positive for p53 protein. All nine seminomas and three of six IMTs were only focally positive for p53 protein. The p53 expression in ECs and YSTs was significantly higher than that in IMTs, MTs, and seminomas (P=0.0001). TPA was present in the majority of the seminomatous and nonseminomatous GCTs, and was significantly higher in ECs and YSTs than in seminomas, MTs, and IMTs (Ki-67, P=0.0001; PCNA, P=0.0006). In the majority of the cases PCNA expression was higher than Ki-67 expression (P=0.0001). The mean TPA percentage was significantly higher in the p53-positive tumors or tumor components (EC and YST) when compared with the mean TPA percentage in those neoplasms that were focally positive or negative for p53 protein (Ki-67, P=0.003; PCNA, P=0.046). p53 expression was also associated with histologically aggressive tumors (ECs and YSTs) that also exhibit high TPA. No relationship appears to exist between the three tumor markers and the clinical stage or the patients' follow-up and outcome in this small series. Further studies are necessary to elucidate the roles of p53 and proliferation markers in testicular tumorigenesis and as prognostic markers.
abstract_ja: Ki-67およびPCNAに対するモノクローナル抗体を用いて、セミノーマ性および非セミノーマ性の精巣胚細胞腫瘍26例においてp53発現と腫瘍増殖活性（TPA）を評価した。純粋セミノーマ8例と非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍18例があり、合計45個の腫瘍または腫瘍成分であった。非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍は混合型または純粋型で、絨毛癌、胎児性癌、未熟奇形腫、成熟奇形腫、セミノーマ、卵黄嚢腫瘍を含んでいた。非セミノーマ性の36個の腫瘍または腫瘍成分のうち16個（44%）でp53タンパクが陽性であった。胎児性癌11例中10例（91%）、卵黄嚢腫瘍8例中3例（38%）、成熟奇形腫10例中2例（20%）、絨毛癌1例が陽性であった。セミノーマ9例はすべて、未熟奇形腫6例中3例は巣状にのみ陽性であった。p53発現は胎児性癌と卵黄嚢腫瘍で、未熟奇形腫、成熟奇形腫、セミノーマより有意に高かった（P=0.0001）。TPAもセミノーマ性および非セミノーマ性腫瘍の大半で認められ、Ki-67およびPCNAの両方で胎児性癌と卵黄嚢腫瘍において、セミノーマ、成熟奇形腫、未熟奇形腫より有意に高かった（Ki-67 P=0.0001、PCNA P=0.0006）。大半の症例でPCNA発現はKi-67発現より高かった（P=0.0001）。p53陽性の腫瘍または腫瘍成分（胎児性癌と卵黄嚢腫瘍）では、巣状陽性または陰性の腫瘍と比べて平均TPAが有意に高かった（Ki-67 P=0.003、PCNA P=0.046）。p53発現は、高いTPAを示す組織学的に侵襲性の高い腫瘍（胎児性癌と卵黄嚢腫瘍）とも関連していた。この小規模な症例群では、3つの腫瘍マーカーと臨床病期または患者の経過・転帰との間に明確な関連は認められなかった。精巣腫瘍発生におけるp53および増殖マーカーの役割と予後マーカーとしての有用性を解明するには、さらなる研究が必要である。
